σχίσμα.long: a rent, as in a garment; a division, dissention.
σχίσμα.sd: a split or gap ("schism"), literally or figuratively
σχίσμα.as:
* σχίσμα, -τος, τό
(< σχίζω),
a rent (Arist., al.): Mt 9:16, Mk 2:21. Metaph., a dissension, division: Jo 7:439:1610:19, I Co 1:1011:1812:25.†
SYN.: v.s. αἵρεσις

σχολάζω.long: (a) I have leisure, (b) I stand empty (of a house).
σχολάζω.sd: to take a holiday, i.e. be at leisure for (by implication, devote oneself wholly to); figuratively, to be vacant (of a house)
σχολάζω.as:
σχολάζω
(< σχολή), [in LXX: Ex 5:8, 17, Ps 45 (46):10 (רפה ni., hi.) * ;]
to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in: I Co 7:5; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, Mt 12:44, Lk 11:25 (T [WH], R, om.).†

σχίζω.sd: to split or sever (literally or figuratively)
σχίζω.kj: break, divide, open, rend, make a rent
σχίζω.as:
σχίζω
[in LXX chiefly for בּקע ;]
to cleave, rend: Mt 27:51, Mk 1:1015:38, Lk 5:3623:45, Jo 19:2421:11; metaph., in pass., to be divided into factions, Ac 14:423:7.†

σχοινίον.sd: of uncertain derivation); a rushlet, i.e. grass-withe or tie (generally)
σχοινίον.as:
σχοινίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), [in LXX chiefly for חֶבֶל;]
a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jo 2:15, Ac 27:32.†

σχεδόν.der: neuter of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192 (ἔχω) as adverb;
σχεδόν.as:
** σχέδον
adv.
(< ἔχω), [in LXX: II Mac 5:2, III Mac 5:14, 45 * ;]
1. of place, near.
2. Of degree, almost, nearly: Ac 13:4419:26, He 9:22.†

σχολή.long: leisure, a school, place where there is leisure.
σχολή.sd: properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment)
σχολή.der: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192 (ἔχω);
σχολή.as:
σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Ge 33:14 (κατὰ σ., לְאִטִּי), Pr 28:19, Si 38:24 * ;]
1.leisure.
2. Later (from Plato on),
(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture;
(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Ac 19:9 (for the later sense of employment, v. MM, xxiv).†

σχῆμα.sd: a figure (as a mode or circumstance), i.e. (by implication) external condition
σχῆμα.as:
σχῆμα, -τος, τό
(< ἔχω), [in LXX: Is 3:17 (פֹּת) * ;]
figure, fashion: I Co 7:31, Phl 2:8.†
SYN.: v.s. μορφή
